zara-sales: Heads up  Orion POC is blocked. Dedicated pool request in asia-south1 sits pending; deployer returns 403 quota_exceeded. Customer requires APAC-only for demo. Can we triage?

pete-ps: pool id orion-poc-5. Deployer error: HTTP 403 Forbidden {"error":"quota_exceeded","msg":"No GPUs available in asia-south1 for project orion-demo"}

lia-eng: Likely an a100-80gb request with az_affinity. We don't auto-downgrade when az_affinity==true.

ops-bot: EVENT: provisioning_attempt queued orion-poc-5 at 2026-03-25T10:35:00Z. Provider quotas: a100-80gb:0, a40:4. Auto-fallback disabled due to az_affinity flag.

zara-sales: Customer's security asked for single-AZ. Any short-term unblock?

mark-oncall: We have 1x a100 in infra-reserve-apac but it's tagged. Need product-ops OK to rebind; takes ~10m.

pete-ps: Alternative: offer quantized model on a40 in-region and share a 1-page perf note (small perf delta). If they accept, we can run full demo today.

lia-eng: I'll draft perf note now: a40 quantized shows ~3% slower median latency, memory down ~35%. Good for functional demo.

zara-sales: I'll ask Orion SRE/legal if they accept a40 for demo. Meanwhile can ops raise quota with cloud?

ops-bot: ACTION: quota_increase_request submitted (ticket GCP-56789). Expected response 1-8 hours.

mark-oncall: product-ops approved temporary rebind of 1x a100 to orion-poc-5. Doing manual bind now.

ops-bot: NOTE: manual_rebind completed orion-poc-5 -> infra-reserve-21 at 2026-03-25T10:52:05Z

zara-sales: Orion agreed to temporary rebind for demo. Sending them options and a pricing snippet for a 14-day reserved POC (pro-rata billing, one allowed SKU substitution). Closing blocker but will follow up with postmortem. :thumbsup:
